text:
ada: opened PR with a tiny migration guide + examples for tool-calling and structured outputs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999 — need quick reviews on canonical shapes and the SDK snippets

liam: reading now. question: do we standardize on `tool_call` or allow multiple top-level variants? SDKs prefer one deterministic shape.

ada: prefer a single canonical top-level object for new examples: `{\"tool_call\": {\"name\": string, \"arguments\": object}, \"meta\": {}}`. include a legacy appendix mapping arrays/unions to this object.

soph: added compact TS + Python normalize helpers in the PR. TS snippet: ```ts
export function normalize(resp:any){ if(Array.isArray(resp)) resp = resp[0]; if(typeof resp === 'string') try{ resp = JSON.parse(resp) }catch{} if(resp?.tool_call && typeof resp.tool_call.arguments === 'string') try{ resp.tool_call.arguments = JSON.parse(resp.tool_call.arguments) }catch{} return resp }
```

liam: nice. CI flagged a bad link: /docs/old/tool-guide.md -> 404

ci-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/tool-guide.md -> 404 (line 31)

ada: thanks, will switch to /docs/reference/tool-calling.md and push a fix. also adding a short guardrails list at the top: 1) top-level object preferred, 2) single `tool_call` when invoking, 3) avoid top-level anyOfs. keep it short.

soph: pushed a tiny pragmatic fallback parser for partial/streamed output: ```py
try:
  obj = json.loads(text)
except:
  m = re.search(r"\{.*?\}", text, re.S)
  obj = json.loads(m.group(0)) if m else {}
```

liam: can we add a recommendation about argument sizes? large `arguments` hit KV/cache. recommend keeping serialized args < 8KB and include a trimming helper.

ada: added trimming helper + migration checklist and a short test prompt example so reviewers can reproduce failures: "Call `weather.get` for \"NYC\" and return a `tool_call` object with `arguments` as an object."

ci-bot: docs pre-check passing aside from one snippet permalink warning.

ada: I'll fix permalinks and merge if CI green and no objections by tomorrow 10:00 PT. release-bot: please schedule a docs build on merge.

release-bot: scheduled docs build on merge; will publish permalinks if build succeeds.

liam: LGTM — small wording nit left. soph: I'll let you follow up with an integrations ping after deploy.

soph: will do. thanks!
